answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ocean of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Each submission hangs on the sparrow of a task receipt, and the cipher is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, split across independent auditors, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
